name: Neeta Sagar

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Neeta Sagar writes in Hindi and English. Her Kabita Live poems move between the tenderness of everyday companionship and a firm concern for women’s dignity. ‘आओ कभी यूं ही मिलते हैं’ imagines friendship through tea, shared memories and shelter under a tree, while ‘Love’ lets rain and moonlight carry an affection that remains unspoken.

Her social poems question the injustice of blaming women for violence committed against them and affirm their strength and rights. Elsewhere, ‘सुस्वागतम ऋतुराज’ welcomes spring through colour, fragrance and a returning refrain. ‘सपने टूटने लगे’ turns towards parents waiting for a grown child, giving absence a quiet domestic setting.
